player_prompt.intro:
Wena uyisomja {player_id} eSimpleTak.
Ebhodini, amatshe akho anezona njengama-'{player_stone}' kanti amatshe akho msizi anezona njengama-'{opponent_stone}'.

Kwezakho, khetha iseli esihle (ngebheji wayo) faka itshe lakho lapho.
Njengesibonelo, '[12]' lifake itshe lakho eselini 12.

Inhloso yakho kukhulisa indlela eya kwesokunxele kwamatshe akho eyachanganya izixhumanisi ezimbili ezifanana zebhoja (phezulu-kwapha kanti kwapha-kwapha).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Inombolo yeselini engahambisani {cell_num}. Ingakafiki ukuba phakathi kwalezi zinga-0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Inombolo {cell_num} seyivele igcwele. Khetsa inombolo lengenalutfo.
